description: Traceable evidence required before a research agent can publish a synthesis.

requiredEvidence.description: The finished research brief or report.
A bibliography or source ledger with stable references.
A claim-to-source map or research log.

completionCriteria: Every material claim can be traced to at least one recorded source.
Source and claim ledgers are structured, use unique IDs, and reject dangling claim-to-source references.
The source ledger distinguishes primary evidence from commentary.
The synthesis records uncertainty, disagreement, and material evidence gaps.
